work.summary: First Japan fanclub photobook of Korean model 표은지 (Pyo Eunji). The original 168-page book and the First Visit to Japan commemorative cover have the same contents according to the artist-store description. Original and commemorative covers are distinct physical editions; the 150-page PHOTO BOOK 2022 annual is a separate work.

edition.contentSummary: First Visit to Japan Commemorative Edition of Pyo Eunji Japan fanclub photobook. The artist-store page snapshot (crawled last month) explicitly says this special cover celebrates the May 2022 first Japan visit and that contents are identical to the original fanclub book: 168 pages, A4, reference JPY 4,800 including tax. The live localized page displays MYR 141.00 tax included, disabled SOLD OUT button and members-only notice. Actual commemorative-edition publication date and publisher imprint/ISBN are unverified; May 2022 is an event reference, not a stored release date. A clean cover thumbnail is selected for the edition; the separate Sold Out overlay image is retained as listing promotional provenance. No interior-page sample verified. Remote image URLs only; no pixels mirrored or reuse license asserted.
